$comment: Recovered from finance-industry.mtse 2026-08-28 via `tool show --raw`, after
the cleanup pass deleted this file while the tool was live. See
WHY A CUSTOM TOOL AT ALL: none of Alation's 79 base tools reads Policy
Center. Business policies are created through a bulk endpoint that returns
a task id and NO object ids, so an id can only be recovered by searching
the namespaced title afterwards — which is exactly what this wraps.
AUTH: CLIENT_CREDENTIALS, i.e. the OAuth bearer alone. Verified separately
that the bearer works on /integration/v1/ — the earlier 403 on that path
was Policy Center being disabled, not an auth-surface difference. Do NOT
add a TOKEN header alongside it: Alation authenticates as the TOKEN's user,
so a token minted for the wrong user_id turns a working call into a 403.
SECRETS DO NOT ROUND-TRIP. A read returns client_secret truncated to
'****YjE1', so ${ALATION_CLIENT_SECRET} is filled from .env at deploy time
by _expand_env. A missing var raises rather than storing the literal
use_pkce was true on the recovered config. PKCE belongs to the
authorization-code flow, not client credentials, so it is almost certainly
an inert default — omitted here rather than carried forward as cargo.
name: Find Business Policies
description: Search Alation Policy Center business policies by title text and return their integer ids, titles and descriptions. Use this before creating a CDE overlay standard, to find the id of the policy the standard derives from. Returns a list; match the title exactly rather than assuming the first result is right.

search.description: Title text to search for, e.g. 'BCBS239'. Omit to list all.
